newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks surge across 1,700-point mark.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks surge across 1,700-point mark.

text.p: Pakistani stocks surged across the 1,700-point mark on broad-based buying on Sunday, a day ahead of pro-business leader Nawaz Sharif's oath-taking as prime minister, dealers said.
"People are celebrating Sharif coming to power. The surge is sentiment-driven. People have high expectations that the new government will have pro-business policies," a dealer said.
The Karachi 100-share index rose 63.85 points, or 3.90 percent, to 1703.13 half an hour before the close. Gainers beat losers 316 to 35. Hub Power rose 1.90 to 41.
